hardware.collective: two-link ring all-reduce on replicated hidden states; full-attention decode uses persistent width-sharded-L1 async buffers

per_device_layout.inter_layer_residual_contract: replicated BF16 tile-layout DRAM [1,1,M,2816]; every row-parallel contraction completes its collective inside the decoder layer, so there is no gather, reshard, or all-reduce at a decoder-to-decoder boundary
per_device_layout.weight_policy: column-sharded QKV/gate/up, row-sharded O/down; norms and router replicated
per_device_layout.expert_policy: all experts resident but TP-sharded; gate-selected top-8 sparse execution only

memory_envelope.note: The full-stack allocator bounds each sliding layer to 1024 tokens (25 layers x 2 MiB/device = 0.048828125 GiB); the advertised-context layer probe deliberately allocates a full 262144-token stress cache and is not the stacked allocator. Five BF16 full layers consume 2.5 GiB/device at context 262144. Each full-attention decoder owns three 4x hidden-width persistent CCL buffers (2.0625 MiB/device), only 10.3125 MiB/device across the five full layers and already covered by the conservative 6 GiB workspace reserve. The conservative total therefore remains 19.411328125 GiB/device, leaving 12.588671875 GiB on each 32 GiB P300C. The 262144 context and batch-32 serving gates are independent maxima; a simultaneous batch of 32 users each at maximum full context exceeds P300C DRAM, so no public context reduction is introduced.

implementation.embedding: hidden-dimension TP4 BF16 ROW_MAJOR followed by one entry all-gather
implementation.lm_head: tied BF16 vocabulary TP4; four 65536-token shards remain split for sampling
implementation.cache_dtype: BF16 for both layer kinds; decode update tensors remain BF16

memory_envelope.calculation_basis: serialized TTNN tensor-cache sizes from the real-weight [layer 0, layer 5] reduced probe; TP-sharded tensors divided by four, replicated tensors counted once per device
memory_envelope.page_tables_and_sampler_note: The five sequential full-attention layers share one three-buffer persistent async-all-reduce pool (2.0625 MiB/device); page tables, sampling parameters, and a one-token local-logit buffer are covered by trace/workspace reserves. State allocation enforces one global 262144-token full-cache budget across active slots; batch 32 therefore has 8192 full-attention tokens per equal slot while retaining an independent 1024-token sliding ring per slot. The conservative batch-32 profile adds 1.513671875 GiB over batch 1 for those sliding rings.

datatype_sweep.calculation: The BFP8_B candidate halves only the 2.548828125 GiB/device BF16 KV term; all other conservative full-model terms are unchanged. Both candidates retain the 262144-token contract, so no advertised capability is reduced.

notes: No context reduction: batch 1 retains 262144 tokens and the public generator passed an all-30-layer non-aligned 262111-token prefill plus first traced decode. The batch-32 serving profile divides the same 262144-token global full-attention cache budget into 8192 tokens per equal slot. The conservative worst validated profile is 22.285305300727487 GiB/device, leaving 9.714694699272513 GiB/device. The optimized full-model stage freshly passed mixed non-aligned 33/47-token prompt handling with fixed slots, an inactive row, changed-only page tables, and full-stack batch 32.
